description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayConnection component, focusing on its status checks and message rejection behavior. It includes mock implementations of WebSocket components and sets up test cases to validate the connection handling.

classes.name: FakeWebSocketTask
classes.description: A mock implementation of WebSocketTasking to simulate WebSocket behavior for testing purposes.

classes.name: FakeWebSocketSession
classes.description: A mock WebSocket session that returns FakeWebSocketTask instances.

methods.name: makeTestGatewayConnection
methods.description: Creates and returns a GatewayConnection instance configured with a test WebSocket session.
